column1: # ZAP rule overrides for `task audit:dast`: <rule id>\t<IGNORE|WARN|FAIL>\t<reason>.
# None yet. Every warning of the first run (2026-10-26) was triaged and kept at WARN,
# so a new instance of it still shows; the verdicts, for the next reader:
#   100000 Server error (API): a 501 from /auth/token/exchange, federation not configured
#          in config/e2e.toml. Not silenced: the same rule is how a real 500 shows up.
#   10024  Token in URL (API): presigned attachment URLs and the ntfy/Gotify/Alertmanager
#          compat endpoints, whose clients send the token that way. By design.
#   90004  CORP missing (API /healthz): harmless; CORP on the API would block attachment
#          images the web app loads cross-origin.
#   10055  CSP style-src 'unsafe-inline' (web): known; CSS injection, not script.
#   90004  COEP missing (web): left out on purpose, require-corp would block attachments.
#   10027, 10049, 10109 (web): comments in vendored bundles, cacheable static assets,
